questions.text:
Develop an abstract base class named Vehicle that includes attributes such as vehicleType
(String e.g., "Car", "Truck", "Motorcycle"), fuelLevel (an integer and as a percentage from 0
to 100), isEngineRunning (a boolean indicating if the engine is running), and mileage (a
double representing the number of kilometers driven). The Vehicle class should have the
following methods:
startEngine() : starting the engine and reduces the fuel level by 1% for every engine start.
stopEngine() : which sets isEngineRunning to false and increases the fuel level by 0.5% when the
engine is stopped.
checkFuelLevel() :which prints the current fuel level and advises refueling if below 10%
accelerate() : acceleration, increases mileage by 10 km, and reduces fuel by 2% for every 10 km
driven.
Next, create a derived class named Car that extends the Vehicle class and overrides the
startEngine() method to reduce fuel by 2% instead of 1% on engine start, and the accelerate()
method to simulate fuel consumption, decreasing the fuel level by 2% for every 10 kilometers
driven. The Car class should also implement the Electric interface, which includes a method
Page 1 of 3
chargeBattery() to simulate charging the battery. This method should increase the battery level by
10% per cycle, ensuring it does not exceed 100%.
In Main class with a main method, an object of the Car class need to create, and demonstrate the
functionality of the Vehicle and Electric methods by simulating engine starts, fuel consumption and
battery charging. Include logic to print the vehicle's current fuel level, mileage, and battery status
after each action.
questions.reason: Abstract Vehicle with fuel/engine/mileage methods, Car overrides, Electric interface with battery charge, full demo. Non-obvious multi-type design → Hard.
